interject_note: True, and measured (Qoder CN 0.5.3, pid <local>, 2026-11-05). The earlier note here said false, and it was wrong for a reason worth keeping: the probe looked for the control once, at rest, while the composer was empty. At that moment the only affordance is 停止生成 / 正在执行中 · 20s, so 'no interject channel' looked true. The real sequence is three steps -- paste (a real input event, not ValuePattern) -> force Enter once or twice -> the composer clears, 发送消息 becomes 停止生成 and a 插话 Button appears at 1990,1618 78x30 -> click it and the queued message enters the running turn. Verified end to end: after the click the transcript grew 318 -> 340 lines and the status line changed to 考虑不同角度. So the control is not missing, it is late.
